question: Look for FDA safety communications about montelukast. Summarize only the returned notice titles or excerpts, link to them, and explain if full notice text was not retrieved. No personal treatment recommendations.
answer:
## FDA safety communications located

- **“FDA requires Boxed Warning about serious mental health side effects for asthma and allergy drug montelukast (Singulair)”** — FDA Drug Safety Communication, **March 4, 2020**.  
  FDA’s notice states that it is requiring a **Boxed Warning** about serious mental-health side effects, including suicidal thoughts or actions; it also says the agency is strengthening existing warnings and recommending that montelukast not be the first-choice treatment for mild allergic rhinitis.  
  Source: [FDA Drug Safety Communication](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-asthma-and-allergy-drug)

- **“Montelukast (Singulair): Drug Safety Communication—FDA requires boxed warning about serious mental health side effects”** — FDA notice listed in the FDA archive.  
  Source: [FDA Drug Safety Communications archive](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/drug-safety-communications)
